corrections.what: Drew the gavel head as one true rectangle system on a single axis at 34 deg: two equal bands (rounded rectangles 24.5 x 10.1 px on the centreline, corner radius 2) centred on the head, body sides straight, parallel and square to the bands
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry and right angles. On the sheet the head is a slight parallelogram: band long edges run at 33 to 34 deg while the line through the band centres sits 2.8 deg off square, so the lower band sits about 1.2 px left of the upper one. Band ends measured at u -15.6/9.05 (upper) and -16.55/7.7 (lower) in the 34 deg frame; both are now -15.75/8.75. The lower band's right end moves 1.05 px and its left end 0.8 px.

corrections.what: Kept the handle as a closed outline at W whose outer edges follow the sheet (11.1 px wide at the tip, 7.6 px at the head), and cut its slit as a constant 1.5 px stadium over the last 20 px before the tip (u 48.2 to 62.9 in the head frame, from about crop (151, 85)) with a mask
corrections.why: Review fix (should). The sheet's handle is an outline whose inside shows as a slit near the tip; at W the strokes alone open only a sub-pixel hairline. Widening the sides to open a 1.5 px slit would push the outer edges 0.5 to 1.1 px past the sheet and leave a shoulder where the slit starts, so the slit is a real cut instead. Outer edges stay within 0.3 px of the sheet; the sides stop just short of opening on their own (2.75 px from the axis at the tip), so the cut alone shapes the slit.

corrections.what: Drew both body sides and the handle before the bands, and shortened the upper band's black inner edge to a butt-capped segment between the band's corner arcs, (111.6, 38.46) to (128.59, 49.92)
corrections.why: Review fix (must). The black round caps of the body sides and of the inner edge poked out past the red band corners at crop (108 to 112, 35 to 39), (129 to 134, 49 to 54) and (110 to 115, 71 to 76). Now the red bands cover the body ends, including the lower band over the end of the right side, as the red sheet shows.

corrections.what: Made the check cell a square, 27.9 px on the centreline with corner radius 2
corrections.why: DR-03 right angles. It measures 27.7 x 28.1 px; fitted corner radii 1.8 to 2.6.

corrections.what: Gave the page one corner radius, 4.5 px, at its three corners
corrections.why: DR-03. Diagonal profiles give centreline radii of 4.1, 4.6 and 4.7 px.

corrections.what: Made the two upper information rules equal, x 26.4 to 69.45
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. They measure 26.31 to 69.56 and 26.56 to 69.31.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The page and bands measure 5.5 to 5.9 px; the handle-side strokes near the tip 4.9 px.

notes: Kept: the page as an open contour (right edge stops at y 51.6, well above the gavel; bottom edge stops at x 65.6), the separate base rule under the gavel, the check whose long arm pokes just past the cell's top-right corner, the hollow slots inside both bands, and no sound block. Red follows the red sheet: each band is red on its upper long edge and both short ends, while the long edge nearer the lower left (the upper band's inner edge, which is also the body's end, and the lower band's outer edge) is black on the red sheet. The catalogue only says 'short end-band strokes', so the red sheet decided. Layering: the body sides and handle lie under both red bands, so the bands' corners stay clean red; only the upper band's inner edge and the lower band's outer edge are drawn black on top, between the corner arcs.
